title: Astro Portal session event payload: device_stop
description: STOP reached a smart telescope in mode expérimental: its motion and the operation that drives it (its own plan included) were stopped, never parked. Recorded when the stop was sent; `outcome: refused` when the device could not take it. Recorded by the application from the driver's own code path with the night's clock; every field but the ones marked required is optional, and a reader tolerates a payload without them. Private in a shared night. See session-events.md.

cause.description: Optional: `person` — the STOP the person pressed; `night_end` — the stop that closes a night (« Terminer la nuit », the automatic closure). Absent means the application did not say.

family.description: Optional: the smart telescope's family (`seestar`, `dwarf`, `vespera`, `origin`) when the device is one.
